about.title: From production line to code
about.lead: Before studying software development, I spent over six years working in an international industrial environment in Japan — in electrical assembly and supply-chain logistics, under strict quality standards. Today I apply that same discipline to a different kind of system: I write APIs, connect databases, write automated tests, and ship projects from scratch to the cloud.
